MARSH PUSHES FED TO EASE BANK CAPITAL RULES FOR AI LOANS

Marsh ($MRSH) is lobbying US regulators to reduce capital requirements on bank loans protected by credit risk insurance, as AI data-center lending surges.

Barclays is seeking insurance on over $10B in data-center debt, while HSBC is exploring similar deals.

With global data-center spending projected to reach $6.7T by 2030, lenders are seeking ways to offload AI credit risk.

A Fed decision could come by year-end.
